overview.description: The Corgi Ports, Rail & Freight ETF (DOCK) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in industrials equity. The fund invests in companies that own, operate, and enable freight movement across global supply chains. The actively managed ETF targets companies involved in the ports, rail, and freight logistics ecosystem. DOCK was launched on May 6, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.

holdings.infoBox: DOCK is an equity ETF with a total of 47 individual holdings. The top holdings are Union Pacific stock at 8.31%, Canadian National Railway Company at 5.17%, CSX Corporation at 5.09%, Canadian Pacific Kansas City at 4.95%, and PACCAR at 4.84%.
